sets.relationshipLabel: the night creature and the signal it gives off
sets.explanation: A firefly speaks in glow the way a cricket speaks in chirps.

sets.relationshipLabel: the kind of thing, and one of them by name
sets.explanation: Orion is a constellation the way Venus is a planet — the category, then the named member of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: the sky object and the feature it wears
sets.explanation: The moon wears its craters the way a comet wears its tail.

sets.relationshipLabel: the one thing it can never have
sets.explanation: A shadow has no weight, and a ghost leaves no footprint — each is defined by the thing it must lack.
